task: Restore Raspberry Pi 3 SD-card command delivery through the BCM2835 Arasan SDHCI controller
acceptanceCriteria: CMD8 no longer ends with INT_STATUS 0x00018040 or 0x00018000 on the real RPi3
the SD-card probe advances beyond the previous no-card failure
generic targets retain their native SDHCI byte and halfword access path
publicContracts: BCM2835 non-buffer register writes are separated by at least six microseconds
BCM2835 byte and halfword accesses use aligned 32-bit operations
scoutSummary: The card, mapping, power, stable clock, and present-state bits are valid. CMD8 times out identically at 400 kHz and 100 kHz. U-Boot's working BCM2835 driver uses aligned 32-bit access, a transfer-mode shadow, and spacing between non-buffer writes.
